video_title: The latest on Jalen Williams & Cason Wallace after suffering injuries | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams' injury and team resilience
quotes.excerpt: He's not gone forever, he'll be back better than ever and we know it.
quotes.quote: Just feel bad for him. Nothing more than that. It's obviously going to be tough without a player like that. He's not gone forever, he'll be back better than ever and we know it. We just got to hold the fort down till he comes back.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Shams Charania reports on Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace injuries
quotes.excerpt: The Thunder have lost both Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace for most, if not the entire, regular season.

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: The Thunder have lost both Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace for most, if not the entire, regular season.

text_blocks.speaker: Shams Charania
text_blocks.text: Jalen Williams has been diagnosed with a dislocated left ankle as well as a fracture in that same left leg. Cason Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum. He's going to undergo surgery. Both players will have surgeries that will cost them several months of the season, and these are devastating blows to the Thunder who had championship hopes this season.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Shams Charania on Thunder's roster depth and potential trade moves
quotes.excerpt: They do have three first-round picks they can use in trade, they do also have an open roster spot.
quotes.quote: The fact that the Thunder took San Antonio to seven games was a lot of an accomplishment in and of itself because they were down not only Jalen Williams but AJ Mitchell as well. AJ Mitchell is healthy, he's ready to go. Jared McCain, a full season of him. You see Chet Holmgren so far this season has looked much more aggressive. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander already this year is looking like the best player in the world. So they have that going for them. But accounting for Jalen Williams as well now as Cason Wallace being out for the entire season potentially, that is something that's going to be potentially insurmountable for this Thunder group. But they're going to be all steam ahead to try to see if this group as currently constructed can get the job done. They do have three first-round picks they can use in trade, they do also have an open roster spot. So we'll see what happens between now and the February trade deadline as well.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Shams Charania provides injury update on Jalen Suggs
quotes.excerpt: I'm told he's been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in that knee.
quotes.quote: The Magic avoided serious injury here. There is no ACL damage to Jalen Suggs' right knee, but I'm told he's been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in that knee. He's going to be out at least two weeks, but Jalen Suggs will be out for a period of time here while the Magic are already dealing with Paolo Banchero being sidelined for four to six weeks with a high ankle sprain. We know over the last few years the Magic have dealt with various injuries to Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs. When those guys are in the lineup, this is an above-average team.
